newsitem.title: UK: FT Information, Dow Jones, KR forge link.
newsitem.headline: FT Information, Dow Jones, KR forge link.

text.p: Three publishing groups, Britain's FT Information, Knight-Ridder Inc and Dow Jones&Co of the U.S., said Tuesday they had agreed to set up an online news database and to form a London data collection centre.

"These three leading companies are creating a comprehensive global collection of published material that will be fundamentally useful to people conducting business research," the firms said in a joint statement.
The project is intended to provide an international resource for corporate, research, government and academic customers with information from newspapers, magazines and trade publications.

Financial Times Information, part of the information division of Britain's Pearson Plc, will operate on the three participants' behalf a London facility that collates information for distribution throught their respective electronic information services.
For Dow Jones, the agreement will be administered through a newly-formed subsidiary affiliated with its Business Information Services publishing arm.

Knight Ridder Information president Jeff Galt said in the statement that, "what is unique about this effort is that it brings together three widely-respected organizations experienced in both newspaper publishing and electronic business research".
